tweet.text:
⚡ Fine-tune and quantize AI models directly on NVIDIA Jetson.

Our new Jetson AI Lab tutorial shows how to use Unsloth and memory-efficient QLoRA to customize models, export quantized GGUF files, and run them locally with llama.cpp.

Follow hands-on examples for:
🔹 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning on Jetson AGX Thor
🔹 Qwen3.5-4B on Jetson Orin Nano

Start optimizing: https://nvda.ws/45YagAq
